patronOf.en-US: Preacher of the Holy Name of Jesus
patronOf.pt-BR: Pregador do Santo Nome de Jesus

prayerExcerpt.en-US: May we ever be set aflame with the spirit of your love.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Acendei sempre em nossos corações a chama da vossa caridade.

meta.face: A small, gaunt man of about sixty-three, clean-shaven, with a thin, pointed face — a smooth, rounded bald crown with a thin fringe of short grey hair, a long, fine nose curving slightly down at the tip, large, heavy-lidded pale-brown eyes lowered in gentle concentration, sunken cheeks under prominent cheekbones, a small, thin-lipped mouth drawn slightly inward and a prominent, upward-curving chin; a mild, kindly, recollected expression.
meta.basis: He is among the first saints with an authentic portrait: Pietro di Giovanni d'Ambrogio's panels, drawn from life and from the death mask, show a small, emaciated, beardless friar with a sunken mouth, a long nose and a prominent chin, holding the IHS sun. The tablet is shown without the monogram.
